issuing_state.description: State that issued the certificate, from the border or title, e.g. 'Missouri'

document_title.description: Title printed at the top, e.g. 'Certification of Death'

ever_in_armed_forces.description: EVER IN ARMED FORCES: true for YES, false for NO

social_security_number.description: SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBER, or null if the box is blank

residence_address.description: RESIDENCE ADDRESS, or null if the box is blank

surviving_spouse.description: SURVIVING SPOUSE name as printed (maiden name if wife)

cause_of_death.description: Each line under UNDERLYING CAUSE, in order, including significant conditions

condition.description: The condition as printed, e.g. 'LIVER FAILURE'

interval.description: Interval between onset and death printed after the condition, e.g. 'HOURS'

significant_condition.description: true if the line is labelled SIG COND (a contributing condition rather than an underlying cause)

issued_by.description: The ISSUED ON BEHALF OF line: the issuing office or county

title.description: Title under the name, e.g. 'State Registrar of Vital Statistics'
